author: The Q
description:
@xLean-robotics 
The xLean TR1 is one of the most unusual cleaning robots I've tested. Instead of simply following a preset route, it can actively search for dirt, identify where cleaning is actually needed, and target that area automatically. Even more interesting, it can transform into a handheld cleaner for quick everyday messes.

After spending some time with it, I think this approach makes much more sense than cleaning an entire room when only one small area is dirty.
